# Patchbay

> Patchbay is an AI automation and web development agency based in Islamabad, Pakistan, founded and run by Zaheen Zuberi and a team of specialists in design, copy, SEO, and development.

Patchbay builds AI voice agents and calling agents that answer inbound calls, qualify callers, and book appointments, with bilingual English and Urdu handling. It builds AI chatbots for websites, WhatsApp, and Instagram, trained on a business's own content. It works as an n8n developer and workflow automation agency, connecting CRMs, calendars, forms, and invoicing. It builds full-stack websites and web apps in Next.js and TypeScript with server-side rendering and technical SEO built in. It builds custom software and SaaS products, and custom trading bot automation (MT4/MT5 Expert Advisors and crypto exchange bots) for traders with an existing strategy. It also builds custom bots for anything outside trading: Discord moderation and role bots, Telegram alert bots, Slack workflow bots, web scrapers, and auto-fill/form automation bots. It also runs brand, content, and day-to-day social media management. Patchbay works with clients across Pakistan and remotely worldwide, including businesses in the United States and the UAE. Outbound calling is only for people who have consented, and in regulated fields such as health, law, insurance, and lending the voice agent handles intake and scheduling only, with no advice.

Zaheen Zuberi is the founder, based in Islamabad, and is a software developer first; the voice agents, chatbots, and automation work are all built on that same foundation.

- [Brand, Content & Social](https://zaheenzuberi.com/services/marketing-and-social): brand, content, and social media management.
- [Custom Bot Development](https://zaheenzuberi.com/services/custom-bots): Discord, Telegram, Slack, and web bots for anything outside trading, including auto-fill/form automation.
- [Custom Trading Bot Development](https://zaheenzuberi.com/trading-bots): MT4/MT5 and crypto-exchange trading automation, built around a trader's own strategy.
